about: section 4 part two, the garden behind the ring tunnel: scripts/room/garden.py, then scripts/room/encode.mjs garden
units: island units; S, the ring spacing, is 2.5 units (docs/specs/section-4-world.md 2); 1 unit is 1 m of the Blender scene
axis: the flight runs along the island's -z (Blender +y), level, x right and y up; every position here is relative to the flight axis
eyeNote: the flight axis stands this high above the lawn

camera.pose: the glide's end: plate and cards are rendered from here and register exactly here

sun.note: direction points toward the sun, island frame

colour: display values (sRGB through the Standard view), untagged; alpha straight, not premultiplied, clear pixels filled with nearby colour

plate.draw: at infinity, locked to the camera's position: it turns with the roll and scales with the FOV; the lawn's stripes run along the flight, so a still plate stays right as the camera moves

cards.distanceNote: from the render pose along the flight; the card is a plane square to the axis there
cards.worldNote: island units at the card's distance: its width and height, and its centre from the flight axis (x right, y up)
